advice.title: Scientific Agronomist Advisory
advice.deficiency_prefix: Primary Deficiency: Low Nitrogen in soil (260 kg/ha)
advice.deficiency_desc: Due to low nitrogen levels observed in the soil report, vegetative growth may slow down. Apply 30% urea at sowing and the remaining dose with irrigation after 25-30 days.
advice.organic_manure_desc: Incorporate 2-3 tonnes per acre of well-decomposed FYM or vermicompost to enhance organic carbon.
advice.balanced_npk_desc: Phosphorus and Potassium are in optimal balance; avoid excess synthetic application to save input costs.
advice.micronutrients_desc: Apply foliar zinc sulphate spray during the flowering growth phase.

trends.title: Soil Health Trends & Comparison
trends.subtitle: Comparison of Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, and pH across previous 3 seasons.
trends.insight_desc: Continuous farmyard manure and balanced NPK application increased available nitrogen by +40 kg/ha over the past year. Organic carbon increased from 0.38% to 0.45%, improving soil water-retention capacity.
